changes: Runtime loading API uses vlodash.camelcase, vprotobufjs 8.8.1 and vlong; code-generation CLI and its yargs dependency are outside this package.
Reuse private root descriptors and per-type codecs within one load; retain separate mutable public descriptor objects.
Walk namespaces directly and avoid duplicate explicit resolve passes and descriptor Buffer copies.
Treat __proto__ dictionary entries as own data; make isAnyExtension return false for nonobjects.
Self-contained declarations with native Node Buffer inference when available.
